data.text: After casting, no one — not even you (except Blizzard effects) — can deal any damage at adjacent tiles and your tile until end of round.

logic.description: Implemented point-buy damage (Air, Water → Matter) to every living enemy in contact, Σ kept ÷10 rounded half up each, and then the caster hex plus its six neighbours become a no-damage zone until the end of the turn: nobody — not even the caster — deals damage there, except Blizzard casts themselves. A failed roll re-emits only that element.

prerequisites.description: Only Posture / Empty Posture emit the elements of a non-instant cast (Rule 20).
No element of the cast is barred for the caster by a fired Disable (Rule 20 pc override).

effects.description: Rule 20: one point-buy per emission on the caster stat behind the element going out; this is the total number of d6 the whole cast rolls (6·n nearest the stat, ties to more dice).
Σ of the kept dice (one per element, the highest die of each successful roll) ÷10, rounded half up; a failed roll re-emits only that element (cast status retry).
The caster hex and its six neighbours become a no-damage zone until the end of the turn.

validation.description: element_cost stays non-empty and still carries elem_water (the element family that defines the effect).
The number of elements stays within ±1 of the canonical cost.
